basis.current_repository_contract: Knowledge Library v1.0.0 / Jewelry Design Schema v1.0.0
basis.source_boundary: P0-10..P0-13 current JSON artifacts; P0-1..P0-9 prior-chat transcript/completion summaries; live jewelai-v2 repository for implemented target grammar.
basis.important_limitation: Original 56-target Matrix artifact and individual P0-1..P0-9 JSON/MD artifacts are not present in this workspace. Reconstructed canonical IDs are explicitly labeled and must be reconciled before normative schema freeze.

layer_rules.CURRENT_PRODUCT_STATE_V1: Already represented by current authoritative Design Schema / Knowledge Library target grammar.
layer_rules.PRODUCT_STATE_VNEXT: Intrinsic or explicitly chosen design/product property that requires additive schema support.
layer_rules.INTERPRETATION_METADATA: User-intent or scale/semantic evidence used to understand/compile a design but not itself an objective Product State fact.
layer_rules.REFERENCE_BINDING: Feature-level semantics for how a reference constrains or informs a target design.
layer_rules.AI_GENERATION_STATE: Presentation/execution state such as camera, scale instruction or lighting.
layer_rules.OUTPUT_PROFILE: Requested presentation/output characteristics, not jewelry design truth.
layer_rules.VERIFICATION_RESULT: Evaluation of generated media against design/reference constraints.
layer_rules.DERIVED_RUNTIME_METADATA: Deterministically calculated comparison/preservation metadata; does not silently become authoritative Product State.

targets.note: Separates historical/movement reference from structural/product style without replacing existing style.
Allows mixed influences without forcing one exclusive style label.
Stores descriptive aesthetics such as minimalist, delicate, bold or geometric.
Separates physical decorative process from motif/content.
Decoration is location-specific and must not spread automatically.
Distinguishes subtle accent from dominant decoration without inventing dimensions.
Preserves which element is visually dominant when explicit.
Prevents intentional openings from being silently filled.
Stores repetition/alternation/graduation semantics without inventing counts.
Preserves user's original expressive wording verbatim/near-verbatim.
Adds searchable/usable normalized semantics without replacing raw intent.
Represents multi-dimensional intent without forcing a single style tag.
